entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1163 of 2023
Applicant :- Jeet Kumar @ Fauji Lal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.Thru.Prin. Secy. Home Dept. Lko.

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Gaurav Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Shri Gaurav Shukla, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant as well as Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh, the learned A.G.A.-I appearing on behalf of the State.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R./Case Crime No.64 of 2013, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 477A, 120 I.P.C. and Section 13(1)(D) r/w Section 13(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act registered at Police Station- Kotwali, District-Sitapur.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on25.02.2013, stating that in furtherance of order passed by this Court, a vigilance inquiry was conducted by the Vigilance Establishment in which it was found that illegalities had been committed in allotment of liquor shops.

It is stated that in the F.I.R. that one of the shops had been allotted to the applicant also.
4.

After investigation, the Investigating Officer has submitted a charge sheet against the applicant on Jeet Kumar @ Fauji Lal vs State Of U.P.Thru.Prin. Secy. Home ... on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103954588/
1 26.07.2018.
5.

entities.text: Jeet Kumar @ Fauji Lal vs State Of U.P.Thru.Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, having no criminal history and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

6. The State has opposed the prayer for bail by filing a counter affidavit annexing therewith a copy of the charge sheet dated 26.07.2018.
7.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and taking in view of the fact that the shop was allotted in the year 2008; the F.I.R. was lodged in the year 2013; the investigation already stands concluded and the charge sheet has been submitted and the applicant was not arrested during investigation, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

(iv) that the applicant shall appear before the trial court on each date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted; and (v) that the applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
